_about: Coins (Shaked, 2026-10-22): earned by strong answers, spent in the shop and in duels. No monetary value, never bought, never cashed out. Every number here is a decision of Shaked's; change the file, not the code. 2026-11-06 (Shaked: 'i dont want so many coins'): a strong practice answer earns 5, flat (no hard-question bonus), a strong interview turn 10, and a question pays ONCE per user: a second strong answer on the same question, in practice or in an interview, earns nothing. XP is gone.
_about_interview_finished: Shaked, 2026-11-02 ('i want him to try more'): finishing an interview earns coins whatever the result, once at least this many questions were answered. Start-and-quit earns nothing. The amount is Shaked's to change.

quiz._about: American questions from seeds/duel_quiz.json: five a duel, a minute each at most (Shaked, 2026-10-22)

pool._about: the judged mode only. What counts as a short question: the live bank has no question under three minutes by its own estimate and every live question is difficulty 5, so 'short' is a format a person answers in a few sentences. Grows as Harel's short questions reach the bank.

description.en: Raises today's question limit by ten. Tomorrow the plan's limit is back.
description.he: מעלה את מכסת השאלות של היום בעשר. מחר המכסה של התוכנית חוזרת.
